title: Domain Registrations Auto-Renew Loyalty Credit for Transferred-In Domains
content:
Domain Registrations rewards a transferred-in domain kept on auto-renew: the transfer line's autopay credit is one of the Domain Care credits its inbound transfer charge earns.

### Decision table

The transfer line's autopay credit is USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered where the domain's auto-renew setting is on and no declined auto-renew attempt is recorded on it less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match, USD 0.20 for each year the charge covered where the setting is on and at least one such declined attempt is recorded, and nothing where auto-renew is off.

| Auto-renew setting on the domain | Declined auto-renew attempts recorded on the domain in the last 12 whole months | Autopay credit |
|---|---|---|
| On | none | USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered |
| On | one or more | USD 0.20 for each year the charge covered |
| Off | any | nothing |

### Points of judgement

- The setting is the domain's current auto-renew setting; the declines are the declined auto-renew attempts recorded on this domain's service history.
- The window counts whole months back from the day of the price match, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached: on a price match dated 3 October 2029 (hypothetical), a decline recorded on 4 October 2028 falls inside the window and one recorded on 3 October 2028 falls outside it.
- With auto-renew off, no credit is earned whatever the decline history.
